original_requirement: Hai manifest cùng case; hai contract có evidence_id giống nhau; chỉ đúng tuple được liên kết, không đè hàng khác.
observed_result: anchor_links uses composite primary key (chain_id, contract_address, manifest_sha256). Two distinct manifests for the same case ID persist independently without collision or clobbering. Queries return manifest-specific links. Isolation across chains and contracts verified.

original_requirement: Hai custody cùng action trong một giây; cả hai giữ nguyên bằng tx/log identity. Replay đúng no-op; payload khác cùng identity fail-closed.
observed_result: Unique index idx_custody_event_identity on (chain_id, contract_address, tx_hash, log_index) preserves subsecond custody actions within the same transaction. Replay of identical payload is idempotent no-op. Duplicate identity with conflicting payload fails closed.

original_requirement: Event/actor/emitter/calldata sai, receipt revert, block reorg, RPC lỗi: không verified mới; rollback không để event/link half-written. Registration không giả CustodyRecorded.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED (AUDIT BLOCKER 1 RESOLVED): verified=1 is strictly set only when an authentic receipt dictionary is verified against contract address, actor address, tx_hash, block number, block hash, log index, and exact ABI event topics (4 topics for EvidenceRegistered, 4 topics for CustodyRecorded). Rejects incomplete topics, missing transactionHash/blockHash/logIndex, emitter mismatch, or context mismatches with transaction rollback leaving zero half-written state. Registration is categorized as EvidenceRegistered, distinct from CustodyRecorded. Zero INSERT OR REPLACE. FINDING 1 RESOLVED: ABI event data structure and length strictly validated for both EvidenceRegistered (>= 96 bytes, offset 64, URI match) and CustodyRecorded (exactly 64 bytes). Empty or truncated data strictly rejected. transactionHash and blockHash verified as authentic 32-byte hex (0x[0-9a-fA-F]{64}). Zero verified=1 recorded on invalid data. FINDING A RESOLVED: Complete UTF-8 decoding of ABI storageUri, zero-padding validation, and strict cross-validation against canonical case_digest and manifest_sha256. Single-byte URI tampering (e->X) and profile mismatches fail closed with zero verified=1. FINDING C RESOLVED: Canonical custody verification requires exact bytes32 equality between on-chain noteHash and expected SHA-256 hash. Zero implicit zero-padding/plaintext fallback permitted in canonical mode; persist_verified_event strictly fails-closed on plaintext-padded noteHash.

original_requirement: DB mất/lock/read-only/schema thiếu trước send => zero send. Lỗi INSERT/COMMIT sau send => pending + recovery, không retry, không success giả.
observed_result: Pre-send check verifies DB existence, write permissions, and Group 3 schema presence before any RPC execution, failing fast with zero send. Post-send DB failure creates a sanitized recovery sidecar and does not automatically retry. FINDING 3 RESOLVED: Write flows (anchor_evidence, record_custody_action, claim_send) execute pre_send_db_check(migrate=False) before network calls and fail-fast with GROUP3_SCHEMA_MISSING if database is unmigrated, resulting in zero send and zero schema modification. Explicit CLI command migrate-db added for operator-controlled migrations. FINDING B RESOLVED: forensics/exporter.py distinguishes newly initialized databases from existing legacy databases. Standard export operations on legacy databases preserve historical schema completely untouched without creating Group 3 tables or modifying custody_events.

original_requirement: Note ngắn/dài >32, Unicode, khoảng trắng, cùng prefix khác suffix, chuỗi trùng đường dẫn có thật: đúng SHA-256 toàn UTF-8, không đọc file/không plaintext/truncation; input sai bị chặn.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED: note_hash_bytes32 hashes exact verbatim UTF-8 bytes preserving leading/trailing whitespace. Non-string inputs and empty/whitespace-only notes fail fast with ValueError. Operates purely in-memory with zero filesystem probing on path-like strings. Verified across Unicode multi-byte strings (Vietnamese, Japanese, emoji), long notes (> 500 up to 8192 chars), and distinct hashes for same prefix with different suffixes or whitespace. Plaintext notes never leaked in exceptions or logs. Exact bytes32 equality enforced between on-chain noteHash and expected SHA-256 hash in canonical mode without plaintext fallback.

original_requirement: Case dài 1/32/33/64 ký tự, khác case: đúng hash+URI nhất quán; không plaintext ở calldata/event/CLI/log/audit mới. Validation lỗi không echo.
observed_result: Case IDs length 1..64 validated and hashed via SHA-256 to 64-char hex and bytes32. Regex anchored with \A...\Z rejects newlines. Validation errors do not echo invalid input. Zero raw case_id in calldata, events, CLI, audit, or DB tables.

original_requirement: Legacy chỉ read mode tường minh; mixed profile, downgrade, sai hash/URI/emitter không MATCH; package cũ vẫn nguyên bytes.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED: Silent downgrade completely eliminated. Default verification strictly checks canonical profile (SHA-256 case_id and canonical URI). Legacy verification strictly requires explicit legacy_case_encoding=True (CLI --legacy-case-encoding) and returns MATCH with reason code 'LEGACY_PUBLIC_CASE_ID' (never 'OK'). Mixed profiles (legacy case + canonical URI or canonical case + legacy URI) strictly fail with REGISTRY_MISMATCH. Write paths (anchor/custody) strictly prohibit legacy mode. Legacy custody zero-padded plaintext verification strictly gated behind explicit legacy profile (legacy_case_encoding=True); prohibited in new custody writes and canonical verification.

original_requirement: Cùng operation ID retry/restart/concurrent => tối đa một send; intent khác cùng ID bị chặn. Custody ID khác cho phép event nghiệp vụ khác dù payload trùng.
observed_result: Canonical intent serialized with sorted keys produces deterministic SHA-256 fingerprint. Re-executing same operation ID allows at most 1 send. Mismatched intent for existing operation ID raises IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. Distinct custody operation IDs permit separate events with identical payloads.

original_requirement: Crash tại PREPARED/SEND_STARTED/SUBMITTED/trước và sau DB commit; timeout trước/sau broadcast, output malformed: không tự gửi lại, journal không mất lịch sử.
observed_result: Complete lifecycle tracked in onchain_operation_events journal. Timeouts and crashes transition state to UNKNOWN without automatic resend. Journal maintains tamper-evident history across state transitions.

original_requirement: Reconcile với tx hash thiếu/sai/context sai/sidecar sửa/receipt pending/custody trùng payload => chưa chứng minh thì UNKNOWN; reconcile hợp lệ khôi phục DB, lặp lại không đổi event cũ.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED (AUDIT BLOCKER 1 RESOLVED): Reconcile strictly requires an authentic read-only RPC provider (eth_chainId, eth_getTransactionReceipt, and eth_getBlockByNumber) and strictly rejects self-provided Mapping receipt dictionaries. Validates chain identity and verifies block inclusion to protect against chain reorgs. Cross-validates all multi-coordinate fields derived from intent_canonical. RPC errors or pending transactions remain UNKNOWN without false confirmations or broadcast retries. Repeated reconcile calls are idempotent no-ops. FINDING 2 RESOLVED: Reconcile strictly requires canonical block lookup (eth_getBlockByNumber) to return a valid block and verifies block hash against receipt blockHash. Missing block, RPC failure, or client lacking block lookup remains UNKNOWN without false CONFIRMED or broadcast retries. FINDING A RESOLVED: Read-only blockchain reconcile cross-checks complete ABI storageUri string against expected canonical URI; corrupted or mismatched URIs leave operation in UNKNOWN state without confirming. FINDING C RESOLVED: reconcile_operation preserves UNKNOWN on plaintext-padded custody noteHash in canonical mode with zero CONFIRMED.

original_requirement: Migration DB legacy có duplicate/note text/verified cũ: không mất/đổi row; rollback lỗi, chạy lại migration; integrity_check và logical snapshot đạt.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED (AUDIT BLOCKER 2 RESOLVED): Completely eliminated conn.executescript(GROUP3_SCHEMA) which caused implicit COMMITs in Python sqlite3. Implemented native SQLite SAVEPOINT migrate_group3 with statement-by-statement DDL execution, ensuring true atomic rollback if any statement or unique index creation fails. Tested on legacy DB containing duplicate tx_hashes, raw text notes, and verified rows. Logical snapshots confirm 100% byte-for-byte data preservation. Rollback on simulated index conflict leaves 0 Group 3 tables/columns and 100% intact legacy rows. Idempotent rerun and WAL mode verified.

original_requirement: Canary case/note/key64hex/mnemonic giả/password/API token: không xuất hiện ở stdout/stderr/log/audit/sidecar; raw local case field chỉ ở vùng bằng chứng riêng theo policy.
observed_result: Canary case and note excluded from URIs and hashes. Log sanitization replaces canaries with [REDACTED] using longest-match precedence. Sidecar recursively rejects/redacts compound secret keys and hex private keys. Smoke scan across 6 SQLite tables confirmed 0 leaks.

original_requirement: Giữ toàn bộ gates 2A/2B, B01–B08/C01–C12, D1/D1-E1; synthetic public/no override, FAILED declaration, ancestry/UNKNOWN, reason/audit trước send, verify read-only và 0/1/2.
evidence_path: tests/test_onchain_2b.py, tests/test_onchain_d1.py, tests/test_onchain_guard.py, tests/test_onchain_group1.py, tests/test_onchain_group1b.py, tests/test_group2b_smoke.py
observed_result: All regression suites covering Phase 2B, D1, guardrails, Group 1, Group 1b, Group 2b smoke, and Phase 2A pass 100% cleanly. Preflight checks, git ancestry, synthetic rejection, reason allowlist, audit pre-send commit, and exit codes 0/1/2 fully preserved. 521 total tests pass.

original_requirement: Export no-clobber, append-only hash prefix, publish-success/DB-fail giữ package và mẫu cũ không đổi.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED: forensics/exporter.py synchronizes canonical storage URI evidence://sha256/<case_digest>/<manifest_hash>/manifest.json (161 chars) in evidence_exports table metadata. Manifest on disk does NOT contain storage_uri (zero self-referential cycle hazard). Exact manifest file bytes hashed. Collision no-clobber verified (existing directory raises FileExistsError DESTINATION_EXISTS and leaves files untouched). Dual manifests for same case produce distinct URIs. When database insert fails post-publish, published package on disk is retained completely valid intact.

original_requirement: Hai manifest khác bytes cùng case → URI khác; cùng bytes → URI xác định. Sai case hash, sai manifest hash, URI over256 bytes, Unicode/padding/percent/query/fragment/extra slash hoặc hash sai format đều bị từ chối. URI canonical 161 bytes; hash cuối bằng SHA-256 file và không thay đổi sau sinh URI; metadata DB/state/event khớp helper.
observed_result: Canonical URI format evidence://sha256/<case_digest>/<manifest_sha256>/manifest.json strictly enforced (161 ASCII bytes, <= 256 bytes). Trailing newlines, non-hex characters, and whitespace rejected. Self-referential hash cycle validation prevents modification after URI generation. Smoke test verifies dual manifests produce distinct URIs.

original_requirement: Hai process thật cùng DB/operation ID/canonical intent tranh CAS: đúng một process COMMIT claim và gọi send, process còn lại zero send. Kiểm counter quan sát được và Anvil thật, successful path có đúng một transaction/event. Intent khác cùng ID => IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT. COMMIT lỗi/không chắc chắn => zero send của process đó.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED: Two real OS processes via multiprocessing (spawn) concurrently attempt claim_send with barrier synchronization on a real SQLite disk file. Atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE + conditional UPDATE ensures exactly one process obtains can_send=True and broadcasts a real transaction on local Anvil (nonce increments by exactly 1, transaction mined with verified receipt), while the second process obtains can_send=False and sends 0 transactions on Anvil (winner_sends=1, loser_sends=0). Smoke test validates that resend attempts to Anvil refuse broadcast with unchanged nonce.

original_requirement: Kill process tại failpoint ngay sau COMMIT SEND_STARTED, trước send/tx hash; DB durable giữ claim. Restart cùng ID trả UNKNOWN/reconcile-required và không send; reconcile cũng zero send, không tự đổi PREPARED. Lặp restart vẫn zero send.
observed_result: REMEDIATED AND VERIFIED: Tested with real child OS process hard-killed via process.kill() at the failpoint immediately after committing SEND_STARTED in SQLite before any Anvil RPC broadcast. Durable DB state preserved. Restarted runner process calls claim_send and is strictly denied (can_send=False). Reconcile operation executes strictly read-only checks without sending any transactions on Anvil (nonce strictly unchanged). Zero resend verified.
